minutes.headline: Committee approved the new 6-12 high school schematic design and budget summary, and formed a cost-cutting working group.
minutes.summary: The committee approved minutes and monthly invoices, then heard the project manager walk through the schematic design budget, MSBA reimbursement mechanics and value engineering. Members pressed for more cost savings, so a working group was appointed to look for reductions before the MSBA board meeting. Tax-impact estimates from the town's financial advisor were presented, a resident questioned costs, and meeting and public forum scheduling was discussed.

public_comment.topic: Questioned testing, design and drawing costs and escalation, asked for presentations that laymen can understand and for a maintenance cost analysis before Town Meeting.

what_happened.line: The committee approved the schematic design package for the new 6-12 high school and the total project budget summary.
Members appointed a working group to look for cost savings with the designer and project manager before the MSBA board meeting.
The project manager showed that the estimated cost per square foot is above the MSBA cap, so the excess is excluded from reimbursement and borne locally.
The town's financial advisor presented tax-impact estimates for the local share, modeled over 20 and 30 years.
A resident questioned testing and design fees and asked for plain-language presentations and a maintenance cost analysis before Town Meeting.

why_it_matters: The local share of the school's cost, including any amount above the MSBA cap, would be paid through property taxes, so these figures bear on a future tax bill and on a vote residents will be asked to take at Town Meeting.
The working group is the step at which the project's cost could still change before the MSBA board meeting.
